repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
t1 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
delay(20 MIN)
t2 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
diff = t2 - t1
if (diff >= 3) {
    (#Study_AC).airConditioner_setAirConditionerMode("cool")
}

diagnosis.summary: The candidate introduced an absolute-value correction (`if (diff < 0) { diff = t1 - t2 }`) to handle temperature rises. The IR only triggers when the temperature *drops* by at least 3 units (`$t2 - $t1 >= 3`). In the failing trace, the temperature rose from 3 to null (interpreted as a high value), making the raw difference negative. The candidate flipped this to a positive number, causing an extra `setAirConditionerMode` action that the IR would not perform. The fix removes the absolute-value logic to strictly match the signed arithmetic in the IR.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the `if (diff < 0)` block that inverted the difference. The script now relies solely on the raw signed difference `t2 - t1`, ensuring the action only fires when the temperature decreases by 3 or more, exactly as specified in the IR.
